approved_payload.content: Police say a two-year-old girl was taken from her home at Sekurung village and fatally stabbed; she also had burn wounds, as the suspect allegedly set fire to the child's home before leaving with her. Police responding to a kidnapping report at about 11:55 on Tuesday 13 October found community members gathered on Sekurung Mountain, where the child's body was found. A 20-year-old woman who was still at the scene was arrested for murder; police also opened a case of malicious damage to property. Afterwards some community members allegedly set the suspect's house alight. The motive is unclear (police, via Review Online and Limpopo Chronicle). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Sekurung could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Lebowakgomo police station, the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 32 km away.
